name: which searches bring people to the site (rankings: Search Console query read, sourced answer)

client.text: Which searches bring people to the site? Where do we rank?

result.label: Google Search Console, Sep 21 to Oct 19, 2026 (Search Console data runs about 2 days behind)

result.reply: Google Search Console, Sep 21 to Oct 19, 2026, counted 48 clicks from 1,310 search impressions. The top searches were "fresh sourdough loaves" with 31 clicks at average position 1.4, and "custom cakes burlington" with 6 clicks at average position 6.8. Search Console data runs about 2 days behind. Anything else?
